experiment: E1.3 single-link budgets, uplink and downlink, 3.5 vs 7.2 GHz
status: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-11-06, committed before the first run; values and checks are not changed after results are seen
scope: outdoor UE positions and losses from E1.2 (geometry-conditioned TR 38.901 UMa, 200 shadowing realizations)
single isotropic element at both ends (0 dBi); antenna patterns and arrays are E1.4
single user per carrier, no interference: SNR, not SINR
rates are PHY rates while the direction's resources are in use (no TDD duty cycle, no control overhead); this matches the effective-bandwidth normalisation of ITU-R M.2410
propagation is reciprocal: uplink and downlink use the same total loss

rate_mapping.form: SE = 0 if SNR < SNR_min; else min(alpha * log2(1 + SNR), Thr_max)  [bit/s/Hz]
rate_mapping.source: 3GPP TR 36.942 V19.0.0 (ETSI TR 136 942 V19.0.0, 2025-10) Annex A.1 Table A.1; continuity and the inclusive SNR_min boundary confirmed by Table A.2
rate_mapping.caveat: E-UTRA coexistence baseline (64QAM 4/5 DL, 16QAM 3/4 UL caps); conservative for NR; to be calibrated against 5G-LENA in E1.5

downlink_model: gNB total power spread uniformly over the occupied bandwidth N_PRB * 12 * SCS; noise over the same bandwidth with the UE noise figure; the UE is allocated all PRBs
uplink_model: UE transmits its maximum power on n PRBs (n = 1..N_PRB); noise over n PRBs with the gNB noise figure; the reported uplink rate is the maximum over n of n * PRB_bw * SE(SNR(n)) (ties -> smallest n)

F1_link_closure.meaning: the lowest code of the codeset can be decoded at all
F1_link_closure.DL: SNR over the full allocation >= -10 dB
F1_link_closure.UL: SNR on 1 PRB at maximum UE power >= -10 dB
F1_link_closure.source: TR 36.942 Table A.1 SNIR_min (QPSK 1/8 DL, 1/5 UL)

F2_m2410_equivalent.meaning: single-link spectral efficiency that would leave each of 10 equally time-shared users at the IMT-2020 5th-percentile requirement
F2_m2410_equivalent.UL: max uplink rate / occupied bandwidth >= 1.5 bit/s/Hz
F2_m2410_equivalent.derivation: ITU-R M.2410-0 Table 1, Dense Urban-eMBB 5th-percentile user SE 0.225 (DL) / 0.15 (UL) bit/s/Hz, times 10 UEs per TRxP (ITU-R M.2412-0 Table 5(b), Dense Urban-eMBB Configuration A)
F2_m2410_equivalent.caveat: DERIVED, not an ITU requirement: assumes equal time sharing and no interference; equivalent SNR 10.95 dB in both directions under the mapping above

main_eqbw20.description: equal 20 MHz channels (M.2412 Configuration A simulation bandwidth), M.2412 powers and noise figures at both carriers

sens_nf_cfgB_at_7p2.description: as main, but 7.2 GHz noise figures from M.2412 Configuration B (BS 7 dB, UE 10 dB)

sens_eqbw100.description: equal 100 MHz channels at the M.2412 power spectral density (44 dBm per 20 MHz -> 44 + 10 log10(5) = 50.99 dBm); UE power unchanged

parameter_sources.n_prb: 3GPP TS 38.101-1 (Rel-19) Table 5.3.2-1, SCS 30 kHz: 20 MHz -> 51, 100 MHz -> 273; applied unchanged at 7.2 GHz (ASSUMPTION: no 7.125-8.4 GHz band is specified)
parameter_sources.powers_noise_figures: ITU-R M.2412-0 Table 5(b) Dense Urban-eMBB Configuration A (4 GHz); ADAPTED to 3.5 GHz and ASSUMED at 7.2 GHz (docs/E1_PARAMETERS.md)

feasibility_classes_per_profile.K1_both_carriers_both_directions: 3.5 DL, 3.5 UL, 7.2 DL and 7.2 UL all feasible
feasibility_classes_per_profile.K2_7p2_dl_only_with_3p5_ul: 7.2 DL feasible, 7.2 UL not feasible, 3.5 UL feasible (7.2 GHz downlink usable only if the uplink is carried on 3.5 GHz)
feasibility_classes_per_profile.K3_7p2_dl_without_any_ul: 7.2 DL feasible, 7.2 UL not feasible, 3.5 UL not feasible
feasibility_classes_per_profile.K5_7p2_ul_without_dl: 7.2 DL not feasible but 7.2 UL feasible (expected empty; reported as a consistency signal)
feasibility_classes_per_profile.note: classes describe physical feasibility only; no 'beneficial', 'required' or 'energy-optimal' labels in E1

checks.L1_identities: every record: rx = tx + gains - loss; noise = -174 + 10 log10(B) + NF; SNR = rx - noise (abs error <= 1e-9 dB)
checks.L2_reciprocity: uplink and downlink records of the same link, carrier and realization use the same total loss
checks.L3_frequency_offset: main case: SNR(3.5) - SNR(7.2) = 20 log10(7.2/3.5) for DL (full band) and UL (1 PRB), every link and realization (abs error <= 1e-9 dB)
checks.L4_direction_offset: main case, per carrier: DL SNR - UL 1-PRB SNR is the same constant for every link and realization
checks.L5_mapping: mapped SE <= Shannon SE; 0 below -10 dB; <= Thr_max; non-decreasing in SNR (checked on a dense SNR grid)
checks.L6_ul_allocation: uplink maximum rate >= rate at 1 PRB and >= rate at full allocation, for every record
checks.L7_monotone_frequency: for each profile, direction, link and realization: feasible at 7.2 GHz implies feasible at 3.5 GHz (main case)
checks.L8_hand_reference: unit tests reproduce hand-computed budgets and TR 36.942 Table A.2 values
